description: This file defines a PHP trait named LDAPConnectionHelperTrait which provides utility methods for managing LDAP server configuration, including checking if the LDAP server is configured and retrieving configuration details from a YAML file.

methods.name: isLDAPServerConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the LDAP server configuration file exists and is accessible.

methods.name: getLDAPServerConfig
methods.description: Returns LDAP server configuration object, initializing it from YAML if not already set.

methods.name: getLDAPServerConfigFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file path to the LDAP server configuration YAML file.
